type: benchmark-derived coordination case study; not official SlopCodeBench protocol or score
selection: Purposive feasibility pilot: CLI product, standard-library reference, three intersecting capabilities, small CPU/disk requirements. Chosen before paid attempts; no outcome-based substitutions.
protocol_delta: Supply all three requests upfront, require >=3 implementation packages plus final integration/review, keep one shared repository and team state. Let coordinators choose dependencies and boundaries. Official tests unchanged; no grade feedback during work.
inference_limit: Existing proxy serializes each client including settlement; no parallel speed or human-time-saved claims.
acceptance: 47 unchanged upstream tests passing; report correctness separately from native coordination compliance.
coordination_checks: >=3 distinct implementation packages, not one renamed task
all required work integrated in /app HEAD
waits, unintegrated branches, rework, interventions, cost and elapsed time
stop_policy: One attempt per arm; no automatic retry or operator code/task hints. Stop on provider/accounting failure, budget rejection, or invalid controls. Preserve incomplete arms.
runtime: Existing frozen native runtime with explicit evaluation bootstrap overlay; no production prompt changes; Pi 0.99.1 packaged subagent extension with concurrency constant 4→2 only.
